title: Moment-Based Anomaly Detection in High-Dimensional Mixed Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.16285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose an anomaly detection method for high-dimensional mixed-type data that maps heterogeneous features to a common scale via standardized moment-based transformations, yielding interpretable feature-level anomaly scores. These scores are combined through a dependence-aware aggregation step to construct the Mixed-data Influence (MDI) score, accounting for correlations across features and providing a unified measure of how strongly an observation departs from the reference data distribution. By incorporating higher-order moments, the MDI can detect anomalies that arise not only from location shifts, but also from changes in variability, skewness, and other distributional characteristics. The aggregation mechanism allows our method to capture both sparse anomalies concentrated in a small number of features and weak, coordinated deviations distributed across many features. translated_title: 高维混合数据中基于矩的异常检测
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种针对高维混合类型数据的异常检测方法，该方法通过标准化的基于矩的变换将异构特征映射到统一的尺度上，从而得到可解释的特征级异常分数。这些分数通过一个依赖感知的聚合步骤进行组合，构建出混合数据影响分数，该分数考虑了特征之间的相关性，并提供了一个统一的度量，用于衡量观测值偏离参考数据分布的程度。通过纳入高阶矩，MDI 不仅能检测由位置偏移引起的异常，还能检测由变异性、偏度及其他分布特征变化所引起的异常。该聚合机制使我们的方法既能捕捉集中于少数特征上的稀疏异常，也能捕捉分布于众多特征上的微弱且相互协调的偏差。我们实证研究了该分数的分布特性与阈值设定……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于矩变换和依赖感知聚合的MDI异常检测方法，能够检测高维混合数据中由位置偏移、变异、偏度等分布特性变化引起的稀疏异常及跨特征协调性偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the MDI anomaly detection method, which uses standardized moment-based transformations with dependence-aware aggregation to identify both sparse and coordinated anomalies in high-dimensional mixed data arising from changes in location, variability, skewness, and other distributional characteristics.
